body:
G2 Phase 0 revisit for the R1 Amendment 2 knock-on (sponsor disposition 2026-10-10 19:44Z). The G2 job, outcome, staging (E1-E3) and release intent are unchanged.

Change: C4 moves the handoff-loop detector out of R1. It becomes a v0.2 prerequisite of #12. #12 must build the detector (Amendment 1 rule: the same item or chain passes between the same seat pair more than 2 times) before its friction checks (F12-5). Assumption G-A1 is updated accordingly. Also note C1: loop thresholds become configurable in v0.2, which #12's advisory thresholds may share.

pm.analyst: re-append Phase 1 with the amended staged acceptance (docs/ACCEPTANCE_G2_STAGED.md). Delivery handoff for #12/#13 still waits for R1 to merge.
